key_highlights: ASX closed the week higher supported by renewed strength in the major banking sector.
Coles suffered heavy market capitalisation loss as rival Woolworths seized supermarket market share.
Accelerating residential property downturn reflected in Sydney home prices dropping 10% in 237 days and multi-year weak auction markets.
Federal government unwilling to promise net savings in budget update, exacerbating inflation risks and RBA policy pressure.

sectors.trend: Major bank shares rebounded to lift the broader benchmark index despite rising housing market stress.
sectors.implications: Provides near-term index resilience, but home price falls and slowing loan turnover pose medium-term credit growth risks.

sectors.trend: Widening performance gap between supermarket operators alongside structural decline in department store retail.
sectors.implications: Institutional capital reallocating from COL.AX to WOW.AX; discretionary retail remains under pressure from cost-of-living constraints.

sectors.trend: Upstream energy faces domestic gas policy supply shock and jet fuel inflation, while junior gold and lithium explorers see speculative momentum.
sectors.implications: Favours unhedged domestic gas producers; junior resource drilling hits offer tactical upside amid commodity price volatility.

sectors.trend: Severe downturn in residential auction activity and rapid price corrections across Sydney and Melbourne.
sectors.implications: Earnings headwinds for residential developers and construction-linked REITs; commercial asset valuations face cap-rate repricing.

key_themes: Fiscal policy inertia: Government budget updates risk entrenching inflation, constraining RBA monetary easing.
Accelerating residential property correction across eastern capital cities.
Supermarket duopoly market-share realignment favouring Woolworths over Coles.
Escalating energy transition, fuel overheads, and gas supply constraints.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Persistent Inflation and Delayed RBA Rate Cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain exposure to high-yielding liquid majors and floating-rate corporate credit instruments.
Underweight residential developers and mortgage-exposed non-bank lenders; monitor bank provisioning.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Domestic Gas and Aviation Fuel Supply Shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport exposure; tactically overweight upstream energy producers with domestic gas leverage.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Cybersecurity Breaches and Digital Asset Contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid speculative fintech/crypto holdings; prioritise institutions with certified cybersecurity protocols.

opportunities.recommendation: Long WOW.AX vs Underweight COL.AX pairs trade
opportunities.rationale: Woolworths is winning volume market share and operational stability as Coles absorbs margin compression and reputational friction.
Anticipated domestic gas policy supply shock and elevated jet fuel prices provide sustained pricing power.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to gold producers and explorers
opportunities.rationale: High-grade drilling intercepts and macro volatility support bullion price strength and resource sector sentiment.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to residential developers and vulnerable REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Sydney home prices falling 10% in 237 days and worst auction clearance since 2020 elevate settlement and margin risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain core holding in major banks with bond/FX hedges
defensive_moves.rationale: Banking sector momentum is anchoring the index while currency volatility and state fiscal risks persist.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 trading as major bank strength is balanced by housing deflation and persistent inflation headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Sustained upside requires domestic gas price stabilisation, state fiscal discipline, and clear visibility on RBA easing.
key_catalysts: Federal government mid-year budget update and official inflation commentary
Upcoming RBA board monetary policy decision and statement
Quarterly retail grocery sales volume and margin prints
Government policy announcements regarding eastern Australian gas supply interventions
watch_list: Sydney and Melbourne weekly auction clearance rates and CoreLogic home value index
AUD/USD cross-currency rates and Commonwealth bond yield spreads
Wholesale jet fuel and domestic gas spot benchmark prices
Major bank net interest margins and 90-plus day mortgage delinquency rates
